name: Super Racing GT: Drag Pro 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Super Racing GT: Drag Pro is a fun and challenging drag racing game in which you must test your racing skills on a variety of awesome drag strips from around the world. In this drag racing game the controls are realistic – instead of just mashing the acceleration you must time your gear shifts perfectly and find a balance between gear changing and acceleration.
